concepts.why: The code relates print to println wrongly: the println sits in the inner loop, so a line of several prints is never built and each star gets its own line (the run prints * six times, one per line).
This is a relational error: println should end each row after the inner loop, but placed inside the inner loop it ends the line after every star.
The i++ and j++ updates are only copied from the given code; the answer says nothing about them.
The answer does not address the fencepost loop.
